name: Reference library

acceptance: Catalog validates unique IDs
No third-party source vendoring

name: Offline field notes
features: Bounded validated schema-1 notes, locked write transactions and flushed staged replacement (locally tested)
All notes selectable in TUI, newest first; explicit R reload and scrollable full text
Explicit schema-1 JSON export and locked import merge with reassigned local IDs and repeat-safe matching (locally tested)
acceptance: No write without explicit user action
Malformed notes rejected
Concurrent successful appends have unique IDs and no lost entries; invalid/future documents are preserved
Export/import round-trip, repeated backup import, record multiplicity and combined size/count/ID failures preserve existing data

name: Telemetry event stream
features: TUI/finite NDJSON use a lazy lifecycle-host telemetry adapter with bounded history and freshness (locally tested)
acceptance: Tests cover source, clock and sample freshness
No background uploads or implicit files

name: Storage and schema service
features: Bounded validated schema-1 notes, locked write transactions and flushed staged replacement (locally tested)
Explicit schema-1 JSON export and locked import merge with reassigned local IDs and repeat-safe matching (locally tested)
acceptance: Old schemas migrate with fixtures
Interrupted write never silently destroys existing notes
Concurrent successful appends have unique IDs and no lost entries; invalid/future documents are preserved
Export/import round-trip, repeated backup import, record multiplicity and combined size/count/ID failures preserve existing data

name: Power and resources
features: Battery state if OS provides it
acceptance: Unsupported sensors read unknown not zero
Idle profiles measured on supported OS

name: Local network link status
acceptance: Default makes no outbound requests
Network data reports source and freshness

name: Settings and permission UI
features: Session-only local host-read pause/resume implemented; persistent per-adapter consent remains planned
Version-1 bounded persistent adapter request/deny/clear preferences and CLI (not authorization; tests authored and pending)
Simulation-only one-shot CLI confirmation and in-process deny-first broker prototype (unverified; real-device consent still planned)
acceptance: Permissions tested before adapter callback
Settings migration and revocation tests
Read/list creates no data files; unsupported/future/duplicate/oversized preferences are preserved and rejected
Stored requested preference never grants hardware/network access; trusted real-device authorization remains unimplemented

name: Accessible console
features: Keyboard-selectable collection/detail views, compact 40x12 layout and smaller-screen fallback (locally tested)
acceptance: 80x24 and smaller terminal fixtures
No status relies on color alone
All panels render at tiny/compact/normal sizes; older entries and wrapped text tails remain reachable after resizing

name: Diagnostics and evidence audit
acceptance: No device probing without consent
Every check reports pass/fail/not-run

name: Physical controls
acceptance: Replay fixture on non-Pi host
Recover cleanly from device unavailability

name: Device broker
features: G1 precursor: in-memory SimulatedBroker uses private broker-scoped leases; real OS handle broker not implemented
G1 source-only virtual disconnect and reconnect invalidate old broker leases; real device enumeration remains planned
G1 precursor: virtual cancel/timeout API only, no real device watchdog
acceptance: Unknown/unapproved device stays closed
Revoke permission blocks adapter invocation
Do not interpret virtual device confirmation as authorization to open a real device
Virtual reconnection never resurrects a previous lease, and disconnected fixtures return a distinct unavailable error
Virtual deadlines must never be misrepresented as real OS device timeout support

name: Wearable display layer
acceptance: Layout fixtures at each profile
Accessible fallback without visual effects

name: Serial transport
acceptance: No implicit port enumeration or open
Malformed frames and unplug tested

name: Hardware event simulator
features: G1 precursor: 11 fixed in-memory virtual fixtures, explicit per-session confirmation and bounded truthful event envelope (new tests pending)
G1 source-only fixed nominal/disconnect-recover/revoke replay with synthetic 0–700 ms times and truthful JSON trace (new tests pending)
G1 precursor: cancellation and injected logical TTL scenarios, with bounded 1–60000 ms timeout (new CI pending)
acceptance: CI runs without hardware
Replay gives same state transitions
Saved requested preference does not start a virtual device; Denied blocks even confirmed simulation
Revocation, close, policy reload and cross-broker replay cannot reuse stale leases
Same replay scenario produces byte-identical traces across repeated runs; all rejected stale/revoked operations remain explicit
Source-fixed replay has at most eight steps, no wall-clock timing, and no auto-regrant
Cancel and deadline boundary permanently invalidate old virtual lease; no implicit restart
Backward logical clock tick fails closed; zero/out-of-range TTL and overflow never open the broker
